unitPrompts:
PRODUCTION SPRITE ATLAS, not a concept sheet. Attached image is the APPROVED DESIGN to match closely. Preserve its charming compact SD proportions, rounded steel helmets, outlined tiny faces, detailed clustered pixel shading, black silhouettes, short sturdy limbs, and detailed little horses. Do NOT simplify to geometric rectangles, stick men, board-like horses, or a newly invented blocky style. The mounted Lu Bu and blue spear soldier in the reference are exact identity/style anchors. New units must look drawn by the SAME pixel artist at the SAME camera angle and detail level. Slight overhead 3/4 view, facing lower-right, NO modern smooth illustration. Crisp square pixel clusters at a consistent scale, no antialiasing.

Output a landscape 3:2 PNG sprite sheet on REAL TRANSPARENT background, with EXACTLY SIX equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows, strict invisible uniform cell grid, no gaps or margin outside the grid. Each row contains THREE character pairs; columns 1-2 are the first character's two poses, columns 3-4 the next character, columns 5-6 the third. Each character occupies its cell without touching edges: keep at least 10% padding all around, including ALL weapons and plumes. Center horizontally in each cell, align feet/hooves at 85% cell height. Infantry body/head height approx 55% of the cell, mounted unit including plumes approx 75%. Infantry must remain smaller than mounted units. All cells have identical physical dimensions. No text, no names, no borders, no gridlines, no colored background, no drop shadows, no terrain, no extra figures.

For EACH listed character, make EXACTLY TWO adjacent frames with identical design, equipment, face, palette, size and view. Frame A: ready idle pose. Frame B: a restrained walk cycle pose, alternate feet/horse legs and slight arm/cape motion, aligned on same baseline. Do not redesign between frames. Do not mirror frame B; both face lower-right. Pixel-art extraction fidelity and clean alpha are critical.

The 12 character pairs in row-major order (three pairs per row) are:
1. guan: green robed red-faced bearded general on FOOT, green cap, crescent glaive
2. lubu: EXACT mounted Lu Bu from the approved image, black/gold armor, TWO long red curved plumes, red cape, chestnut horse, silver halberd

5. dian: stocky brown armored bearded warrior on FOOT with TWO short axes
6. huang: elderly gray-bearded archer on FOOT, bronze helmet, olive armor, red cape, bow

8. ally_sword: BLUE sword infantryman on FOOT, EXACT face/helmet/armor style as reference spearman, replace spear with short sword
9. ally_archer: BLUE bow infantryman on FOOT, steel helmet, bow

11. ally_cav: BLUE helmeted lancer on a small light brown horse
12. mage: BLUE robed young strategist on FOOT with black cap and small pale fan

terrainPrompt:
PRODUCTION PIXEL-ART TERRAIN ATLAS, the attached screenshot is the APPROVED artwork and exact visual target. Reuse its SAME vivid green grass with tiny sparse square speckles, dense scalloped bush foliage with yellow-green highlights and deep green shadows, gray outlined angular rocks. Do NOT replace this with simple flat circles, simple geometric blobs, generic noise, or a modern realistic painting. Match the approved image's pixel cluster scale, contrast, detail density and palette closely.

Output ONE landscape 4:3 PNG atlas: EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, invisible uniform grid, no outer margins, no labels or borders. All 12 cells have equal size. REAL transparent background for isolated foliage and rock cells; fully opaque square textures for grass, dirt and water cells. Strict hard-edged pixel art, no antialiasing, no blurry gradients, no lighting halos or drop shadows.

Cell order row-major, precise:
Row 1 column 1: seamless bright green grass texture copied in style from the approved image's open central grass. Fully cover the square with the same grass color and sparse small dark/light square speckles, no plants or objects.
Row 1 column 2: alternate seamless same grass texture, same base green, sparse speckles, no tall blades.
Row 1 column 3: seamless ochre dirt texture like the central clearing in the approved image, fully opaque square, subtle sparse earth pixels.
Row 1 column 4: shallow sandy ford texture, pale ochre stones and tiny blue water flecks, fully opaque square.
Row 2 column 1: ONE rounded scalloped bush/treetop foliage mass from the approved image's left forest edge, isolated on transparency. A dense irregular rounded canopy with outlined scalloped perimeter, rich clustered green/yellow speckled leaves and dark green interior shadows. Fill 85% of cell, no trunk, no ground square.
Row 2 column 2: alternate irregular rounded dense foliage mass matching approved lower-right forest edge, isolated on transparency, same palette and detail, fill85%.
Row 2 column 3: ONE gray rocky outcrop copied in style from the approved image's upper gray rocks, black/dark gray contour, angular highlights, isolated on transparency, fill75% cell.
Row 2 column 4: alternate smaller group of three gray rocks, same approved style, isolated on transparency.
Row 3 column 1: seamless blue stream surface tile, fully opaque square, blocky blue/teal pixels and sparse short light-blue ripple dashes, same simple overhead PC-game pixel scale.
Row 3 column 2: alternate same stream surface, same blue palette, fully opaque square.
Row 3 column 3: same bright grass as row1col1 with a little sparse dirt mottling, fully opaque seamless square.
Row 3 column 4: same shallow sandy ford as row1col4, alternate pale stones, fully opaque seamless square.

No characters, no weapons, no UI, no lettering, no checkerboard painted into transparent regions. These cells will be sampled directly by a tile renderer. Keep every foliage/rock object's complete black outline inside its cell, at least 5% transparent padding; texture cells fully fill their cell. Assets must look extracted from the APPROVED screenshot, not reimagined.
